message.reasoning: We need to navigate to temporary directory. In Unix, temp dir is /tmp. But we are in a virtual file system. We can use pwd to see current. Then cd? There's no cd tool. But we can use ls with path? There's no path param for ls. But we can use find? Actually ls has no path param. But we can use find to list. But we want to navigate to /tmp. We can use find with path="/tmp". That will list all items under /tmp recursively. But they want list all available files including hidden. So we can use find with path="/tmp" and name=None. That will return all items. Let's do that.
